title: 441 ESLint violations including TDZ setState-before-declaration bug and React Compiler purity/ref errors
impact: Calling setGradingRubric at L1642 before its useState declaration at L1654 triggers a Temporal Dead Zone ReferenceError when initialDraft.gradingRubric is truthy; Math.random() in render/useMemo and render-time ref access break React 19 Compiler invariants and SSR hydration.
recommendation: Move the gradingRubric useState declaration above the useEffect at L1620, fix all react-hooks/purity, react-hooks/refs, react-hooks/set-state-in-effect, and react-hooks/exhaustive-deps violations, and enforce eslint in CI.

title: 79 functions exceed cyclomatic complexity 15 (up to 80) and 73 functions exceed 150 lines (up to 1,444 lines)
impact: Monolithic page and route functions (AssignmentDetailContent complexity=80, NetworkPage complexity=76, api/grade handlePost complexity=61, CreateAssignmentForm complexity=59, gradeSubmission complexity=49) mix Firestore I/O, AI parsing, and UI state, making them brittle and untestable.
recommendation: Split page components >300 lines into feature sub-components and custom hooks, and refactor api/grade and functions/src/grading.ts into smaller helpers with cyclomatic complexity <= 15.

title: 131 type-safety suppressions (104 explicit any, 24 as any, 3 @ts-ignore), including 55 in server/AI libraries
impact: Typing the Gemini wrapper (src/lib/ai/config.ts), question parsers (src/lib/ai/assignment.ts), and grading payloads (functions/src/grading.ts) as any disables TypeScript checking across the core AI and grading pipelines.
recommendation: Replace any annotations and as any casts in src/lib/ai/*, src/lib/firebase-admin.ts, and functions/src/grading.ts with explicit interfaces and remove the 3 @ts-ignore directives.

title: Core domain interfaces (Assignment, Submission, Question) re-declared 4-5 times ad hoc across pages while PhysicsAssignment in types.ts is unused
impact: Local interface re-declarations across 10+ page files have already drifted in field names and optionality, while PhysicsAssignment in src/lib/types.ts:L60 is dead code.
recommendation: Consolidate canonical Assignment, Question, Submission, Course, Notebook, and Resource interfaces in src/lib/types.ts and import them across all pages, API routes, and Cloud Functions.

title: 64 code clone pairs (1,121 lines) plus 5,052 lines of duplicated teacher portal mock pages in workspace-preview-*.tsx
impact: scrubPII is copy-pasted between src/lib/ai/utils.ts:L9-L68 and functions/src/grading.ts:L19-L59, spotlight-cards.tsx is duplicated in two directories, and workspace-preview-pages.tsx/tabs.tsx duplicate 8 teacher pages (including 666 lines of unused exports).
recommendation: Delete unused GradingTerminalView and AssignmentDetailsView exports, deduplicate spotlight-cards.tsx, extract shared API route middleware, and share presentational components between teacher pages and workspace previews.

title: 38 unused files and 71 unused exports across src/ and root
impact: Dead files (including src/lib/gemini.ts, check_portfolios.ts, update_mermaid.py, 16 landing components, and 20 UI/globe components such as 726-line src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx) inflate repo size and account for dozens of lint errors.
recommendation: Delete the 38 confirmed unused files and remove the 71 unused exports identified by knip.

title: Root tsconfig.json excludes functions/ without a unified typecheck script and omits noUnusedLocals/noImplicitReturns
impact: Type errors in functions/src/ are invisible to root tsc runs, stale exclude entry 'scripts' does not match 'tools/', and unused variables pass tsc silently.
recommendation: Add a root 'typecheck' npm script that runs tsc --noEmit on both root and functions/, enable noImplicitReturns in root tsconfig.json, and update exclude paths.

title: ESLint configuration lacks type-aware promise rules, security rules, and complexity guardrails
impact: Unawaited promises, async event-handler misuse, and functions with complexity >50 are not flagged by eslint.
recommendation: Enable @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises, @typescript-eslint/no-misused-promises, @typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports, eslint-plugin-security, and complexity thresholds in eslint.config.mjs.
